copy.headline: Embroidered asymmetric top over wide-leg palazzo trousers.
copy.description: The Hasam Set is quiet grandeur: a softly draped top with an asymmetric fall and fine floral embroidery tracing the neckline and hem, worn over wide-leg palazzo trousers that pool at the floor. Grounded in the house's terracotta and alabaster, it is made for weddings, long dinners and every room she intends to hold.
copy.atelierNotes: Ready-to-wear piece produced in limited runs. Hem draping is finished by hand.

fabric.material: Softly draping woven with embroidered trim
fabric.drapeDescription: Soft asymmetric fall through the top; clean, floor-pooling volume in the palazzo
fabric.finish: Fine floral embroidery tracing the neckline and hem
fabric.careInstructions: Dry clean recommended. Cool iron on reverse.
